title: Apply for a paintball marker permit
summary: You can apply for a permit to own or buy a paintball marker in NSW, which allows you to use it only at authorized venues.
intro:
You need a permit to buy or own a paintball marker (paintball gun) in NSW.

The permit does not allow you to use the paintball marker outside an authorised venue.

You can apply online for a one, 3 or 5-year permit.
who_can_apply: Pass a fit and proper person assessment
Complete the NSW Paintball Marker Safety Training course
Do not need a permit if staying in NSW for less than 3 months and holding an equivalent permit from another state or territory

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to apply for a paintball marker permit.
Submit your application in person at a Service NSW Centre.

more_info.text: Paper applications typically take more time to be processed than online applications.
The same fee applies for a 1, 3 or 5-year permit.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to own a paintball marker in NSW?
faqs.a: Yes, you need a permit to buy or own a paintball marker (paintball gun) in NSW. The permit does not allow you to use the marker outside an authorized venue.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for a paintball marker permit?
faqs.a: Applicants must be aged 18 or over, pass a fit and proper person assessment, and have completed the NSW Paintball Marker Safety Training course.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit if I am visiting NSW for a short time?
faqs.a: You do not need a permit if you are staying in NSW for less than 3 months and you hold a current equivalent paintball marker permit from another state or territory.
